rationale.elffile-*: Upstream prebuilt files are preserved; rewriting/stripping proprietary binaries is prohibited.
rationale.unknown-spdx-license-identifier: Upstream has no application license identifier; unknown is deliberate and is not replaced with an invented license.
rationale.python findings: Vendored protobuf and bundled development/skill scripts use application-managed or optional Python environments.
rationale.foreign architecture findings: Upstream bundles Android/ARM/musl/macOS prebuilds; they are not loaded on this x86-64 glibc target.
rationale.Qt findings: Optional Qt5/Qt6 shims are not required by the GTK desktop entry.
rationale.unused-sodepend: Upstream binaries may declare legacy libraries without dynamic references; preserve the binaries.
rationale.dependency-not-needed: Explicit Debian requirements and dynamically loaded launcher dependencies remain declared.
rationale.dependency-implicitly-satisfied: Bash is supplied by Arch base and Artix base.
rationale.caller subsets: Optional-provider detection groups the same callers differently; only subsets of reviewed caller/import lists are accepted.
rationale.optional Python: Python is explicitly optional for bundled helper scripts; the reviewed finding enumerates only imports/callers in the known-good payload.
